create_metric_reporter: create a MetricReporter instance with ConsoleChannel to aggregate and report model training metrics
add_batch_stats: add batch predictions, targets, scores, and loss to the MetricReporter for aggregation
report_metric: report aggregated metrics and loss to all configured channels after a training epoch
compare_metric: compare two metric values to determine which model performs better using lower_is_better logic
calculate_loss: calculate the weighted average loss across all aggregated batches using batch sizes as weights
